answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the horizon index resolves every citation against the sable checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the thread audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2936 identities would post 1487 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
